2089.name: FieldKind
2089.docs: The kind of value a field holds, guessed from sample data.

981.name: new
981.docs: A nested list over the array field `data_member` of each master row.

1081.name: barcode
1081.docs: A barcode showing the value of `expression`.

2162.name: columns
2162.docs: The fields to show, as columns, in order.

500.name: Label
500.docs: Text content of a label or table cell.

1154.name: LinkLabel
1154.docs: A label that is also a link.

1027.name: even_style
1027.docs: Style name applied to even rows of a detail band.

146.name: TextBlock
146.docs: Text already broken into lines and positioned.

1354.name: Stretch
1354.docs: Fills the box, ignoring its proportions.

573.name: CalculatedField
573.docs: A field computed from an expression.

346.name: now
346.docs: The time `Today()` and `Now()` return; the system clock when `None`.

1200.name: sorted
1200.docs: Orders the points by their argument, as numbers when they all are.

2154.name: rows_of
2154.docs: The rows of `data` at `data_member` (or the data itself).

392.name: image
392.docs:
An image from its source text, decoded once: a logo on every page, or the
same photo on many rows, is one image.

492.name: Style
492.docs:
Appearance settings. Every field is optional so styles can be layered:
built-in defaults, then a named style, then the control's own settings,
then conditional rules.

1146.name: Table
1146.docs: A grid of cells, each a label.

1473.name: can_grow
1473.docs: Grows downwards to fit wrapped text (true by default).

592.name: data_member
592.docs: Sets the path to the rows in the data.

138.name: Ellipse
138.docs: A filled and/or outlined ellipse inscribed in `rect`.

465.name: MAX_IMAGE_BYTES
465.docs: The most memory decoding one image may use.

565.name: DataSource
565.docs: A named source of report data, stored with the layout.

938.name: repeat_header
938.docs: Repeats the header on every page the group continues on.

384.name: new
384.docs: An engine with the embedded Inter font.

484.name: blocks
484.docs: Lays out every band instance in print order (page bands excluded).

1138.name: CheckBox
1138.docs: A check mark from a boolean expression, with optional text.

584.name: new
584.docs: An empty report on A4 paper, in US English.

1992.name: word_wrap
1992.docs: Wraps long text onto more lines (true by default).

2165.name: page
2165.docs: Paper; landscape when there are many columns.

503.name: paginate
503.docs: Places blocks on pages, then adds page headers and footers.

1157.name: Bookmark
1157.docs: An entry in the document's outline.

2038.name: model
2038.docs:
The report definition: page, bands, groups, controls and styles. It is plain
data (serde), saved as JSON (`*.rvreport.json`) and built in code with the
fluent methods below. Units are points (1/72 inch).

376.name: engine
376.docs:
Rendering: binds data to bands, groups and sorts rows, lays out each band
instance (controls grow to fit their text), and paginates.

1030.name: keep_with_next
1030.docs: Keeps the band on the page of the band after it.

149.name: clip
149.docs: The control's box; the image is cut there.

576.name: report_header
576.docs: Printed once, at the top of the first page.

549.name: picture_rect
549.docs: Where an image goes in its control's box.

1203.name: data_member
1203.docs: An array field of the current row to chart, instead of the rows in scope.

2084.name: invoice
2084.docs:
An invoice: seller and customer blocks, an item table from a nested
collection (master-detail), totals, notes.

649.name: DataSourceKind
649.docs: How a data source obtains its data.

976.name: filter
976.docs: Nested rows for which this is false are left out.

1076.name: visible
1076.docs: The control is left out when this is false.

2157.name: wizard
2157.docs:
The report wizard: a finished table report from a data source and a choice
of fields, like the wizards of commercial report designers. Also lists the
fields a data source offers, for field lists.

495.name: control
495.docs: Lays out a control at `at`; returns its final height.

1149.name: Panel
1149.docs: A container whose controls move together.

595.name: parameter
595.docs: Adds a parameter with a default value.

1022.name: visible
1022.docs: The band is left out when this is false.

568.name: filter
568.docs: Rows for which this expression is false are left out.

14.name: page_svg
14.docs:
A page as SVG, for previews, tests and debugging. Text uses the Inter
font the document was measured with.

441.name: header_level
441.docs: Group level this block opens a header for (repeated headers).

1095.name: style
1095.docs: Sets style settings on the control.

1749.name: field
1749.docs: Adds a cell showing an expression, with an optional format.

2076.name: invoice_data
2076.docs: An invoice with its items, as a single master row.

2049.name: Rng
2049.docs: A small deterministic random generator, so samples are the same everywhere.

487.name: band
487.docs: Lays out one instance of `band`; `None` when it is hidden.

1141.name: Line
1141.docs: A straight line across the control's box.

1241.name: new
1241.docs: A series named `name`, with `value` for each row.

687.name: headers
687.docs: Extra request headers. Secrets belong in the server's configuration, not here.

233.name: document
233.docs:
The rendered result: pages of positioned primitives, in points. The viewer
and every exporter draw this same structure, so they cannot disagree.

560.name: name
560.docs: The report's name, also the document title.

1087.name: check_box
1087.docs: A check box for a boolean expression.

733.name: letter
733.docs: US Letter portrait (8.5 × 11 in) with 0.5 in margins.

279.name: value
279.docs:
The value behind the text, when it is one number, date or truth value,
so data exports can write the value and not its formatted text.

2041.name: paint
2041.docs: Draws document pages into a RavenRS [`Scene`] for on-screen previews.

933.name: repeat_header
933.docs: Prints the header again at the top of each page the group continues on.

579.name: Group
579.docs: A grouping level with its header and footer.

1987.name: border_width
1987.docs: Border width in points; 0 for none.

552.name: decode_picture
552.docs:
Decodes a PNG or JPEG from a `data:` address or base64 text. Limits protect
a server from a small file that expands into huge pixels.

2087.name: path
2087.docs: The path used in expressions, such as `Customer.Name`.

98.name: page_footer
98.docs: The part of `items` that the page footer printed.

979.name: detail
979.docs: Printed once per nested row; `[^.Field]` reads the master row.

1079.name: chart
1079.docs: A chart: one series of `value` per `argument`.

1279.name: expression
1279.docs: An expression giving the content, such as `[Sku]`; it wins over `text`.

1706.name: TableRow
1706.docs: A table row; its height grows to its tallest cell.

1025.name: keep_with_next
1025.docs: Keeps the band on the same page as the band that follows it (headers).

1352.name: Zoom
1352.docs: As large as fits, keeping its proportions, centered.

571.name: Parameter
571.docs: A value supplied when the report runs.

1071.name: y
1071.docs: Top edge, from the band's top.

1398.name: url_expression
1398.docs: An expression giving the address, such as `'mailto:' + [Email]`; it wins over `url`.

1825.name: controls
1825.docs: The controls, positioned relative to the panel.

390.name: render_with
390.docs:
Renders `report` over `data`. Expression errors do not stop the render:
they are listed in [`Document::errors`] and shown in place.

163.name: Bookmark
163.docs: An entry in the document's outline. Prints nothing.

490.name: Control
490.docs: A printable element of a band.

590.name: embedded_data
590.docs: The data of the report's source when it is stored in the layout.

1471.name: expression
1471.docs: An expression whose value is shown, such as `[Total]`.

690.name: query
690.docs: The query; `@Name` binds a report parameter.

2225.name: ravenrs_report

1998.name: border
1998.docs: Adds a border of `width` points in `color` on `sides` (`all`, `bottom`, `top bottom`...).

563.name: culture
563.docs: Culture for numbers and dates, such as `pt-BR` or `en-US`.

1317.name: mode
1317.docs: How the image fits the control's box.

736.name: content_width
736.docs: The width between the side margins, where bands are laid out.

1163.name: Chart
1163.docs: A chart of the rows in scope, or of a nested list.

582.name: report_footer
582.docs: Printed once, after the last row.

1790.name: style
1790.docs: Style settings on top of the named style.

2090.name: FieldInfo
2090.docs: A field of a data source, as a field list shows it.

2163.name: group_by
2163.docs: Group rows by this field, with a header and subtotals.

1155.name: Link
1155.docs: Text that opens an address when clicked in a PDF, a spreadsheet or a web page.

147.name: Text
147.docs: Lines of text in one font, clipped to a box.

1355.name: Normal
1355.docs: At its natural size (one pixel to a point) from the top left, cut at the box.

574.name: styles
574.docs: Named styles that controls refer to.

393.name: text_system
393.docs: The text system used for measuring, to paint documents with the same metrics.

2155.name: fields
2155.docs:
The fields of the rows of `data`, from the first few rows, nested objects
flattened to `Parent.Child`.

493.name: FormattingRule
493.docs: Formatting applied when a condition holds.

593.name: filter
593.docs: Keeps only rows where `expression` is true.

1474.name: grows
1474.docs: Whether the label grows to fit its text.

1020.name: height
1020.docs: Height in points before any control grows.

466.name: MAX_CACHED_IMAGES
466.docs: How many decoded images an engine remembers.

566.name: data_source
566.docs: The data source that feeds the report (the first one when unset).

12.name: page_text
12.docs:
All the text of a page in reading order, one line per text line (for
tests, search and accessibility).

939.name: page_break_before
939.docs: Starts each group on a new page.

385.name: register_function
385.docs: Adds a function to the expressions of every report this engine renders.

1239.name: value
1239.docs: The number for each row, such as `[Quantity] * [Price]`.

685.name: Json
685.docs: Data stored in the layout itself (samples, small lookup tables).

2193.name: table_report
2193.docs:
Builds a table report: title, column headers repeated on each page, zebra
rows, optional grouping with subtotals, grand totals, page numbers.

1085.name: bookmark
1085.docs: An outline entry showing the value of `expression`, at `level`.

858.name: default
858.docs: The value when none is supplied.

2039.name: paint_page
2039.docs:
Paints `page` with its top-left corner at `origin`, `scale` logical pixels
per point. Draws the white paper with a soft shadow, then the content.

277.name: align
277.docs: How the text is aligned in its box.

1158.name: Bookmark
1158.docs: An invisible entry in the document's outline, at this control's position.

577.name: page_header
577.docs: Printed at the top of every page.

550.name: PictureMode
550.docs: How a picture fits its box.

2085.name: sales_dashboard
2085.docs: A sales dashboard: one page of charts over the same orders.

96.name: page_header
96.docs:
The part of `items` that the page header printed. Exporters that flow
pages together keep it only once.

1077.name: rules
1077.docs: Conditional formatting, applied in order when the condition holds.

2158.name: caption
2158.docs: A readable caption for a field path: `UnitPrice` → `Unit Price`, `Customer.Name` → `Name`.

496.name: chart_data
496.docs:
A label's text and the value behind it, when it has one.
Evaluates a chart's points from the rows in scope or a nested list.

596.name: ParameterKind
596.docs: What kind of value a parameter takes.

1023.name: page_break_before
1023.docs: Starts a new page before the band.

242.name: channels
242.docs: How many color channels the original file has: 1 gray, 3 color; 2 or 4 with transparency.

569.name: sort
569.docs: Sorting of detail rows within their groups.

15.name: print_html
15.docs:
The whole document as a standalone HTML page sized for printing: one
sheet per page, with the Inter font embedded so it prints as measured.
Open it in a browser and print, or save it as PDF from the print dialog.

442.name: report_header
442.docs: The report header: printed above the page header on the first page.

1096.name: visible
1096.docs: Prints the control only when `expression` is true.

1069.name: name
1069.docs: An optional name, shown in the designer and in error messages.

388.name: Report

161.name: level
161.docs: How deep it is: 0 at the top.

488.name: Band
488.docs: A horizontal strip of the page holding controls.

688.name: Url
688.docs: JSON fetched over HTTP(S) when the report runs.

7.name: culture
7.docs: The culture the document was formatted with (`pt-BR`, `en-US`).

1315.name: source
1315.docs: The image: a `data:image/...;base64,` address, or just base64.

934.name: page_break_before
934.docs: Starts each group (after the first) on a new page.

1988.name: borders
1988.docs: Which sides have a border: any of `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`, or `all`.

553.name: keep_value
553.docs:
Records on the text box just drawn the value behind its text. A format with
literal text around the value (`Total: {0:C2}`) keeps it text.

1434.name: expression
1434.docs: An expression giving the text, such as `[Region]`; it wins over `text`.

980.name: footer
980.docs: Printed after the nested rows; aggregates in it cover them.

1280.name: show_text
1280.docs: Prints the content under a linear code.

272.name: PlacedLine
272.docs: A line of text at its position on the page.

45.name: into
45.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

1026.name: odd_style
1026.docs: Style name applied to odd rows of a detail band (1st, 3rd...).

1353.name: Squeeze
1353.docs: Like zoom, but a small image is not enlarged.

572.name: calculated_fields
572.docs: Fields computed from other fields, usable like data fields.

491.name: look
491.docs:
Resolves a style from layers (each a named style and own settings,
later layers winning), then conditional rules on top.

1472.name: format
1472.docs: A format for the value: `{0:C2}`, or just `C2`.

691.name: Sql
691.docs: A SQL query run by the report server against a named connection.

464.name: MAX_IMAGE_SIDE
464.docs: The largest side of an image, in pixels.

564.name: data_sources
564.docs:
Where the data comes from, saved with the layout. The engine renders
whatever data it is given; designers and the report server load it from here.

10.name: errors
10.docs:
Problems found while rendering (expression errors, missing data), with
where they happened. The document is still produced.

383.name: ReportEngine

156.name: Vector
156.docs:
Vector shapes that belong together, such as a chart or a barcode. PDF and SVG write
them as they are; the screen and spreadsheets get them as one picture.

483.name: rows
483.docs: The report's rows: located, filtered and sorted (group keys first).

583.name: page_footer
583.docs: Printed at the bottom of every page.

556.name: filter_and_sort
556.docs:
Filters and sorts rows; returns them as owned JSON (cheap enough at report
sizes, and it frees the result from the input's lifetime).

2.name: decode
2.docs: Decodes base64 text, ignoring whitespace; `None` when it is not valid.

1083.name: picture
1083.docs: A picture from a `data:` address or base64 text.

856.name: label
856.docs: What the user is asked for.

1510.name: expression
1510.docs: A boolean expression for the checked state.

2164.name: totals
2164.docs: Number fields that get totals (group subtotals and a grand total).

502.name: text_box
502.docs:
Draws a text box (fill, borders, text); returns its height, grown to
fit the text when `grows`.

929.name: expression
929.docs: Rows with the same value of this expression form a group.

148.name: rect
148.docs: Where the whole image is drawn; it can be larger than `clip`.

348.name: RenderOptions
348.docs: Settings for one run of a report.

775.name: expression
775.docs: The expression to sort by, such as `[Name]`.

2083.name: sales_by_region
2083.docs:
Sales grouped by region and city, with subtotals, a grand total, zebra
rows and a highlighting rule. `rows` sample rows are embedded.

1202.name: format
1202.docs: How numbers are shown, such as `N0` or `C2`.

94.name: items
94.docs: What is printed, back to front.

975.name: data_member
975.docs: The array field of the master row that holds the nested rows.

1075.name: style
1075.docs: Style settings on top of the named style.

494.name: Look
494.docs: A resolved style with defaults filled in.

1021.name: controls
1021.docs: The controls, positioned relative to the band's top-left corner.

2002.name: merged
2002.docs: Settings of `other` override these where `other` has them.

567.name: data_member
567.docs:
Path to the rows in the data (`orders`, `report.lines`). Without it, an
array of data is the rows and an object is a single row.

440.name: row
440.docs: Top-level row printed by this block (for page aggregates).

1748.name: text
1748.docs: Adds a cell with fixed text.

2075.name: sales_data
2075.docs: `count` sales rows: date, region, city, customer, product, quantity, price.

1067.name: kind
1067.docs: What the control is and its content.

159.name: Link
159.docs: An area that opens an address when clicked. Prints nothing.

486.name: DetailReport
486.docs: Master-detail: a nested list printed after each row of the report.

1240.name: color
1240.docs: Its color; one from the palette when absent.

686.name: url
686.docs: The address; `{?Name}` inserts a parameter value.

5.name: base64
5.docs: Base64, for images carried in layouts and in printable HTML.

1086.name: field
1086.docs: A label showing the value of `expression`.

732.name: a4
732.docs: A4 portrait (210 × 297 mm) with 1.5 cm margins.

932.name: footer
932.docs: Printed after each group; aggregates in it cover the group.

151.name: DocumentImage
151.docs:
A decoded image, with the file it came from: exporters can embed the file
itself, which keeps JPEG photos small and unchanged. Clones share the data.

551.name: safe_url
551.docs:
Whether a link's address is one a reader can open safely: data can fill
links in, and a `javascript:` or `file:` address must not reach a document.

2086.name: customer_list
2086.docs: A customer list grouped by the first letter, the simplest kind of report.

978.name: header
978.docs: Printed before the nested rows (only if there are any).

2159.name: default_format
2159.docs: The default format for a field kind in a culture-neutral way.

270.name: clip
270.docs: The control's box; text outside it is clipped.

597.name: parameter_label
597.docs: Sets what the user is asked for the parameter added last.

1024.name: page_break_after
1024.docs: Starts a new page after the band.

570.name: parameters
570.docs: Values the user supplies when running the report (`?Name` in expressions).

343.name: parameters
343.docs: Parameter values by name; missing ones take their defaults.

443.name: Block
443.docs: A laid-out band instance: its height and items relative to its top-left.

1751.name: style_name
1751.docs: Uses a named style for every cell of the row.

1197.name: argument
1197.docs:
What each point is about, such as `[Region]`. Rows with the same value add
up into one point; without it, every row is a point.

1070.name: x
1070.docs: Left edge, from the band's left.

389.name: count_rows
389.docs:
How many rows of `data` the report would print: after its data member and
filter, before grouping. Lets a scheduled job skip a report with nothing in it.

162.name: y
162.docs: Where on the page it leads.

489.name: controls
489.docs:
Lays out controls at `origin`, moving controls below a grown one down by
as much as it grew. Returns the bottom of the content.

1143.name: Shape
1143.docs: A rectangle or ellipse, filled with the style's background and outlined with its border.

1470.name: text
1470.docs: Fixed text, used when there is no expression.

589.name: data_source
589.docs: Adds a data source and makes it the report's source.

689.name: connection
689.docs: A connection name from the server's configuration (never a connection string with a password).

462.name: CHART_MUTED
462.docs: Text on a chart's axes and legend.

562.name: PageSettings
562.docs: Paper size and margins, in points.

1316.name: expression
1316.docs: An expression giving the image in the same forms, such as `[Photo]`; it wins over `source`.

308.name: text
308.docs: The text of the line, without the line break.

281.name: format
281.docs: The format specifier that turned `value` into the text (`C2`, `dd/MM/yyyy`).

2043.name: samples
2043.docs:
Ready-made reports with sample data: the designer's templates, the
benchmarks' workloads and living documentation of the report model.

154.name: shapes
154.docs: The shapes, back to front, in the page's coordinates.

1135.name: Label
1135.docs: Text: fixed, or from an expression.

581.name: detail_reports
581.docs: Nested reports printed after each row's detail (master-detail).

1435.name: level
1435.docs: How deep it is: 0 at the top, 1 under the 0 before it, and so on.

554.name: backdrop
554.docs: Fill and borders of a box.
